notes: The exact mappings below follow the canonical IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador API header. The scenario resolves each adapter-supplied class/member name and handle successfully while joined, then checks FederateNotExecutionMember for the same valid inputs after resignation with the connection still open.

requirements.statement: The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for getObjectClassHandle. The test first resolves an adapter-supplied object-class name while joined, then verifies that exception after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for getObjectClassName. The test supplies an object-class handle first proven valid by a successful joined lookup and verifies that exception after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for getAttributeHandle. The test resolves an adapter-supplied defined attribute on a valid object class while joined and verifies that exception after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for getAttributeName. The test supplies an object-class/attribute pair first proven valid by a successful joined round trip and verifies that exception after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for getInteractionClassHandle. The test first resolves an adapter-supplied interaction-class name while joined, then verifies that exception after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for getInteractionClassName. The test supplies an interaction-class handle first proven valid by a successful joined lookup and verifies that exception after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for getParameterHandle. The test resolves an adapter-supplied defined parameter on a valid interaction class while joined and verifies that exception after resignation while connected.

The standard API declares FederateNotExecutionMember for getParameterName. The test supplies an interaction-class/parameter pair first proven valid by a successful joined round trip and verifies that exception after resignation while connected.
